decisions: The official Farside all-data page is accessible from the GitHub runner (HTTP 200) and is linked from the official /btc/ page (which returns HTTP 403); the readiness allowlist now accepts both URLs under the same institutional.primary source identity.
Do not compare BTC/USDT directly as USD/BTC or average exchange quotes into a synthetic quote.
Keep Kraken as the canonical price-source candidate; captured trades remain review-only until acceptance gates pass.

ETF daily rows are now parsed reproducibly from the official Farside all-data HTML. The parser preserves dashes as null, marks the all-dash 14 Oct row as UNREPORTED_PLACEHOLDER, and leaves observed_at null.
Farside and TFTC values agree within display rounding on 5, 6, 8, 9, 12 and 13 Oct; 7 Oct remains a material delta largely attributable to BRRR, but revision/time alignment is unresolved.
TFTC remains an unapproved mirror candidate; no source priority was changed.
DXY remains blocked until a specific accessible authorized feed and observation-time convention are approved.
HTTP Date/Last-Modified/ETag/cache headers are response metadata, not metric observed_at or proof of provider revision.
No observations were ingested; no production database, scenario state, monitoring state or probabilities were changed.

Official Binance market-data-only endpoint https://data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/trades?symbol=BTCUSDT&limit=1000 is accessible from the GitHub runner (HTTP 200), while api.binance.com returns HTTP 451; this adds a reproducible cross-check path, not a canonical USD/BTC source. Bybit's official recent-trade endpoint still returns runner-specific HTTP 403.
